job.title: Registered Manager
job.description:
Registered Manager Children's Residential Home
Salary: up to £55,000 per annum
Location: SO41


We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Manager or a Deputy Manager who is looking to step up to support the effective leadership of a child-centred residential home that is currently home to 2 children. This role is key to ensuring the home consistently meets Ofsted regulations, delivers high-quality care, and promotes positive outcomes for children.
Working as the Manager, you will help maintain a safe, nurturing, and stable environment, underpinned by therapeutic practice and strong safeguarding principles.


Key Responsibilities
·Safeguard and promote the welfare of children in line with legislation and best practice
·Lead, supervise, and develop the staff team to deliver consistently high standards of care
·Contribute to care planning, risk management, and regulatory compliance
·Participate in the on-call rota when required
 
Requirements


·Minimum 2 year's experience in a children's residential management role
·Strong knowledge of Ofsted standards, safeguarding, and quality assurance
·Hold a either a Level 3 NVQ or Level 5 Diploma in Leadership & Management
·Profficient in de-escalation of challenging behaviours
·Full UK driving licence


Working hours are Monday to Friday 0900-1700 however this may vary in accordance with the needs of the home with sleep ins paid in addition at £55 per sleep.


If you are passionate about delivering high-quality, child-focused care and ready to take the next step in your leadership career, please APPLY NOW!

job.title: Residential Childcare Worker
job.description:
Support Worker - Children's Home
Location: Winchester
Hourly rate: National Living Wage, with rates of up to £13.15 per hour (depending on experience)
Job Type: Temporary - please state what is applicable
Shift Pattern: Flexible shifts available, including days, nights, sleep-ins, weekends and long days.
About the Role
 
At First for Support, we're looking for compassionate and reliable Children's Support Workers to join our growing team, providing temporary staffing to children's homes in Hampshire.
 
As a Children's Support Worker, you'll play an important role in supporting children and young people in residential care settings.  You will help provide a safe, supportive and nurturing environment, build positive relationships and support young people with their daily routines, activities, education and emotional wellbeing. No two days are the same, giving you the opportunity to make a real difference while enjoying the flexibility that temporary work offers.
 
Your Responsibilities
 
As a Children's Support Worker, your responsibilities may include:
 
·Provide high-quality care and support to children and young people.
·Build positive and trusting relationships.
·Support daily routines, activities and independence.
·Promote positive behaviour and emotional wellbeing.
·Follow care plans, risk assessments and safeguarding procedures.
·Complete accurate daily records and reports.
·Work effectively as part of a team and alongside other professionals.
 
What We're Looking For  


We're looking for candidates who:
 
·Have previous experience in a similar role as a Children's Support Worker.
·Are reliable, professional and able to work alone as well as part of a team.
·Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills and enjoy building meaningful relationships.
·Are Caring, patient and resilient.
·Are able to remain calm in challenging situations.
·Committed to safeguarding and promoting children's welfare.
 
In return, we offer weekly pay, flexible temporary shifts, ongoing support from a dedicated recruitment consultant and the opportunity to work with a variety of trusted care providers across Hampshire, gaining valuable experience across different care settings.
Apply Today
 
If you're passionate about supporting children and young people and making a positive difference in their lives, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and a member of the First for Support team will be in touch to discuss your application.
 
Please note: First for Support is unable to offer sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK, as we do not provide Skilled Worker visa sponsorship.

job.title: Support Worker - Children's Home
job.description:
Residential Childcare Worker
Southampton, Hampshire
Full time hours with sleep ins
£13.00-13.75ph
 
We are looking for Residential Childcare Workers for a newly established children's home in Southampton. This is a rewarding role for someone who genuinely wants to make a difference to the lives of children and young people, including those who may have experienced trauma, challenging life circumstances or difficulties with emotional regulation and behaviour.
As a Residential Childcare Worker you will provide high-quality, person-centred care and support to children and young people. Your main will be to build positive relationships with young people, support them with their daily routines and promote positive behaviour to manage challenging situations.
 
Residential Childcare Workers will work closely with the families, social workers and other professionals, follow individual care plans and assist the Young People in activities and appointments.
 
We are looking for individuals who are caring and patient. Good communication skills, resilience, ability to maintain professional boundaries are just some of the skills we will be looking for in an ideal candidate.
 
Previous experience in residential childcare, children's services, social care, education, youth work or a similar environment is desirable. However, we may also consider candidates who have the right attitude, transferable skills and commitment to working with children and young people.
